newsitem.title: URUGUAY: Uruguay's February trade deficit $65.3 mln.
newsitem.headline: Uruguay's February trade deficit $65.3 mln.

text.p: Uruguay reported a $65.3 million trade deficit in February, up from $46.4 million in February 1996 but down from January's $118.8 million deficit, the Central Bank said Friday.
Imports rose to $241.7 million in February from $205.6 million in the same month a year before. Exports were $176.6 million against $159.2 million the same month last year.
In the first two months of 1997, Uruguay's trade deficit totaled $183.9 million, up from $113.8 in the same period of 1996, the Central Bank said..

Imports for January and February totaled $543.6 million, versus $443.1 million in the first two months of last year. Exports for the two month period were $359.7 million versus $329.3 million in Jan-Feb last year.
